scope: Configurable ability classes, equipment and sourced world references

prompts.intent: Build an expandable sourced reference catalog
reference_requirements: Current project contract and runtime/preview capability evidence; primary public references where factual claims are requested.
prompts.prompt: Collect primary public references for {{REFERENCE_SCOPE}}. Separate named models, families, nicknames and prototypes; airframe, link, payload role, maker, origin and operator are independent. Record narrow claims, URLs, access date, status and caveats. Do not claim exhaustive coverage or infer allegiance from appearance. Map each entry to a fictional Xonix role and keep its implementation status reference-only. Read the current project README, ability registry and schema before emitting accepted data; otherwise return a labeled proposal. Preserve source images and record effective prompts. Keep real-world references high-level and all game values fictional.
prompts.example_request: Build an expandable sourced reference catalog for the current Xonix design.
